## How the score was worked out

Each result below implies a score on its own, after adjusting for how hard that test is and who ran it. The model's score is their weighted average. Tests that separate models cleanly and agree with the other tests weigh more. A small pull toward the middle keeps thinly tested models from swinging too far. [Method](../method.md)

## How to run it

version              needs  score
fp16 · nvidia only  ~2.6GB   26.0
</pre>

```sh
# fp16 · nvidia only
uv run --with diffusers --with transformers --with accelerate --with torch python -c "import torch; from diffusers import StableDiffusionPipeline; p=StableDiffusionPipeline.from_pretrained('CompVis/stable-diffusion-v1-4', torch_dtype=torch.float16).to('cuda'); p('a cat holding a sign').images[0].save('out.png')"
```
